images.01: Year 2050, inside a cozy Mars habitat kitchen module: Uzbek astronaut Temur, 35, short black hair, trimmed mustache, white space suit without helmet with a small Uzbekistan flag patch, holding a tablet showing his mother's frozen video call; through a round window red Martian desert and dust. Teal and rust-red palette.
images.01_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but the astronaut is now typing on the tablet with both thumbs and shouting with his mouth open.
images.02: Same Uzbek astronaut Temur in a white space suit standing proudly in a Mars greenhouse dome with green plants, red Martian landscape outside, heroic low angle, year 2050.
images.03: Uzbek mother Saodat, about 60, colorful headscarf tied at the back, flowered housedress, sitting in a Tashkent kitchen with a big plov kazan on the stove, talking worriedly to a laptop video call, warm yellow light.
images.03_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but the mother now proudly holds up a big glass jar of apricot jam to the laptop camera, smiling.
images.04: Space infographic illustration: planet Earth on the left and planet Mars on the right, a thin glowing beam of light traveling between them with a small clock icon, starry black background.
images.05: A cute round white helper robot with a blue screen face and small arms, standing in a Mars habitat holding a clipboard list, a big cargo rocket visible through the window, friendly cartoon look.
images.06: Uzbek astronaut Temur in a white space suit sitting on a rock on Mars at sunset looking at a tiny blue dot Earth in the sky, gentle smile, blue Martian sunset, emotional.
